Run PTP species delimitation (Maximum Likelihood)

Source: R/ptp.R
ptp.Rd

Alias of mptp with method defaulting to "single" (the single-rate PTP model), rather than mptp's own default of "multi" (the multi-rate mPTP model).

Usage

ptp(
  tree,
  method = c("single", "multi"),
  outgroup = NULL,
  outgroup_crop = FALSE,
  pvalue = 0.001,
  minbr = 1e-04,
  seed = as.integer(Sys.time()),
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

tree

A path to a Newick tree file (character) or an read.tree phylo object. Rooted and unrooted trees are both accepted.

method

Coalescent rate model: "multi" (default, recommended) or "single".

outgroup

Character. Name of the outgroup taxon used for rooting an unrooted tree (optional; if omitted, the longest tip branch is used).

outgroup_crop

Logical. If TRUE, removes the outgroup after rooting (default FALSE).

pvalue

Numeric. Significance threshold for the likelihood ratio test (default 0.001).

minbr

Numeric. Minimum branch length; edges shorter than this are excluded from the analysis (default 0.0001).

seed

Integer. Random seed (default: current time).

quiet

Logical. Suppress C-level progress messages (default FALSE).

Value

See mptp.

See also

mptp, ptp_tbl

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
result <- ptp("tree.nwk", outgroup = "Outgroup1",
               outgroup_crop = TRUE)
print(result)
head(result$assignments)

library(ape)
phy <- read.tree("tree.nwk")
result <- ptp(phy)
} # }
